title: Beach Life Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Life is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionBEACH LIFESugar Dunes Condominiums – Seagrove Beach142 Beachside Drive, Unit #7, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights3 bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)3 bathroomsSleeps 8 guestsGulf-front condo with stunning viewsWall-to-wall living area views of the beach and Gulf of MexicoCovered balcony with direct sand accessHome is for saleExperience the ultimate Beach Life at this Gulf-front condo. Just steps from your private back balcony, you can have your toes in the sand—a rare feature for 30A condos. Nestled in Seagrove Beach, approximately halfway between Seaside and The Hub, this location offers privacy while keeping you close to top shops and restaurants.Inside, French windows line the back wall, filling the space with natural light and offering emerald Gulf views from the kitchen, dining, and living areas. Sliding glass doors open to a spacious covered balcony, perfect for morning coffee, a relaxing read in the breeze, or watching a spectacular 30A sunset. This one-story, three-bedroom condo comfortably sleeps eight, making it ideal for families or friends.Community AmenitiesSeagrove Beach, part of Florida’s Emerald Coast, is a mile-and-a-half stretch of serene beach around a small cove. Named for its thick grove of windswept trees, the area retains the green canopy of oaks, magnolias, hickories, and sand pines that have defined it for decades. Seagrove blends historic beach homesteads with newer cottages and offers activities from exploring Point Washington State Forest to shopping and dining along Scenic Highway 30A.ParkingSugar Dunes is a gated community with a maximum of two vehicles per condo in designated spots. Additional vehicles will be towed by the building manager. Two parking passes are provided and must be displayed at all times.Important NotesHomeowners have dogs; guests with allergies should be aware.No smoking.Pets not allowed (except certified service animals with prior notice and documentation).Private beach chairs (including store-bought) are prohibited; guests must rent through Spyglass. Violations incur $100/day fines.Tenants must be at least 25 years old and present during the rental period.Reservation & Payment PolicyPublished rates do not include taxes and fees.50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival (or in full if within 60 days).Cancelations over 60 days before arrival: 5% fee applies; otherwise, initial 50% is fully refundable.Travel insurance available; must be purchased before final payment.Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTTerms of the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override third-party site policies.
rooms_guidance: Guest Bedroom (2 Queen beds): 2 Queen Beds - Shared hallway bathroom has a tub/shower combination
